verdict.rationale: Ramp documents extensive in-product AI insights: auto-categorization/coding, fraud anomaly flagging, spend trend analysis, hotel rebooking suggestions, Ramp Intelligence as a cross-product AI layer, and MCP tools for querying spend data and generating insights (e.g., 'Admins can analyze data to identify spend trends and forecasting insights'). This is corroborated by first-party docs and live probes of the MCP server exposing read scopes across transactions, bills, treasury, etc. missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party validation of insight quality/accuracy, and community evidence is largely about general product sentiment rather than AI-insight specifics.
